goals.0: Talking about opening a current account
grammar.0.title: Bank words
grammar.0.note: When choosing a bank, compare the monthly fee, ATM fees and the cost of sending money abroad. Never give your IBAN and PIN to anyone.
grammar.0.rows.1.1: international bank account number (in Germany DE + 20 digits)
grammar.1.title: abheben (separable) and überweisen (inseparable)
grammar.1.note: Verbs starting with über-, er- take no ge- (überwiesen, eröffnet). Separable ab-, ein-: abgehoben, eingezahlt.
grammar.2.title: Sending money abroad
grammar.2.text: To send money to Bangladesh you usually need the recipient bank's SWIFT/BIC code and the account number (not an IBAN). Fees and exchange rates differ between banks and services — compare before sending and check the rules (declaration limits etc.).

quiz.5.prompt: What is the Partizip II of abheben?
quiz.6.why: Separable verb: ab goes to the end.
quiz.9.prompt: Put the sentence in order: “I would like to open a Girokonto.”
quiz.9.why: Modal verb in 2nd position, infinitive at the end.
